finding.headline: cGuiLayer IS the page class. The object BSP_GuiManager_LoadPage allocates (00AC6600, 124h bytes, vtable 00D5BE38) and the object the render-order doc calls cGuiLayer are the same class: type id 1 of BSP_GuiLayout_CreateWidgetOfType, the element type of the std::vector<GuiScreen*> at manager+14h.
finding.consequence: there is no separate layer container. Priority at +FCh orders the manager's page vector (update and hit test); RenderOrder at +11Ch is the key of the camera-store multimap at manager+8h (draw). A layer reaches the draw map only through the camera store it acquires or shares.
finding.no_update_override: vtable +40h is 00AA87B0, the same target the sibling widget vtable at 00D5BECC carries, so the manager's per-page update and a widget's per-child update are one routine.

winner_rule.meaning: the smallest horizontal half extent among the widgets containing the pointer wins. Not the deepest, not the nearest in Z, not the last in the list.
